title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI metrics hooks and regression thresholds
author: Riley Park
description:
Motivation: Add first-class per-prompt CI hooks to the eval-harness so teams can gate changes by per-prompt metric regressions rather than only aggregate scores. This implements a lightweight hook runner that integrates with our existing CI pipelines, a thresholds config format, and a small set of default thresholds for common prompt-sets.

Summary of changes: 1) add eval/ci/hooks/runner.py (hook runner and CLI wrapper), 2) add eval/ci/configs/per_prompt_thresholds.yaml (config schema + default), 3) extend eval/harness/core.py to emit per-prompt metrics (counts, accuracy, BLEU-like scores) and a compact JSON artifact, 4) CI: update .github/workflows/eval-ci.yaml to call the hook runner and fail the job when any per-prompt metric exceeds configured regression windows, 5) tests: add unit and integration tests under eval/tests/ci_hooks.

Commits (high level):
- 7a1d2f9: initial hook runner and CLI (+docs)
- 9b3c4e1: per-prompt metrics emitter and artifact format
- d4f5e6a: thresholds config and default thresholds for common prompt-sets
- f0e1d2c: CI workflow integration and feature flag gating
- a1b2c3d: tests and flake/typing fixes

Files changed (high-level):
- eval/ci/runner.py (new) - main hook runner, retries, summary output
- eval/ci/configs/per_prompt_thresholds.yaml (new) - user-editable thresholds per prompt-set
- eval/harness/core.py - emit per-prompt metric JSON artifact alongside existing summary
- .github/workflows/eval-ci.yaml - integrate hook runner and artifact upload
- eval/tests/test_ci_hooks.py - unit/integration coverage for runner and threshold parsing
- docs/eval/ci_hooks.md - usage and examples

Testing and CI: Initial run failed on lint (black/ruff) and a flaky integration test under timeout; fixes applied and CI re-ran. Final CI status: all checks passed. Key checks: build (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration-tests (pass), lint (pass), typecheck (pass).

Review thread (condensed):
- Ava: "Can we avoid failing CI for small statistical fluctuations? Suggest adding an adjustable grace window and a per-prompt minimum-sample threshold."
  - Riley: "Added grace_window and min_samples to thresholds schema; default grace_window=0.02 relative, min_samples=50. Updated tests to cover small-N behavior."
- Samir: "Runner looks good but please add metrics to the artifact header for easier tracing (model_id, commit_sha, seed). Also consider making the runner idempotent for CI retries."
  - Riley: "Added header fields and idempotent temp-file behavior; runner now writes to artifact path atomically."
- Jordan: "Docs and examples are great. One request: add a short troubleshooting section for common CI failure modes."
  - Riley: "Added troubleshooting section and mapped common errors to actions (increase grace_window, re-run with --debug)."
- Code owner approvals: Ava (approved), Samir (approved), Jordan (approved).

Backward compatibility and upgrade notes: The per-prompt artifact format is additive; existing aggregate consumers are unaffected. Operators who want to opt-in should add per_prompt_thresholds.yaml into their eval config or set the feature flag EVAL_PER_PROMPT_CI=true in CI. No breaking changes to public APIs.

Release notes: "eval-harness: add per-prompt CI hooks and configurable regression thresholds. Teams can now gate PRs on per-prompt regressions to catch localized quality drops."

Merge: Squash-merged into main after approvals and green CI.
